scope: Proposed full aircraft with non-ruled spline wing; independent candidate, not original-author CAD
limitations: All hidden wing structure is provisional engineering, not authored reference internals
Non-ruled surfaces interpolate the same sections but change geometry between stations
Default OD4/ID3 spar remains structurally unsized
Volume integrals of curved solids are not a trusted mass estimate
Original wing/boom/pod disconnections remain unless explicitly resolved by later hardware
Static servo envelope omits horn, pushrod, bracket, hatch and cable access
continuity_scope: Within each aerodynamic native surface; continuity across leading/trailing edges and the bilateral root seam is not certified

render.display_method: 0.25mm / 0.25rad native-face display tessellation; area-weighted face-local interpolated normals; 2x edge supersampling; no cross-face normal welding
render.scope: Display only; not fit or strength validation

fit.scope: Selected solid geometry and explicitly required contacts only; not manufacturing or flight approval

reopen_assertion_correction.reason: Generator expected8cavity sections from obsolete prototype; actual verified source has16

step_export.scope: Integrated revision review includes native FCStd and GLB only; no STEP verification claim
